en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small park with birch trees, a pond with children playing at the water's edge, and adults sitting on benches. In the background stands a multi‑storey residential building with a tiled roof and awnings. The scene feels calm and suburban. Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin, and a photographer/publisher mark is on the right.
